description:
handle_info({:compaction_ready, ...}) (server.ex:427-543) has no mode guard and unconditionally calls Logic.resume_pulling_from/2 (server.ex:542). lock_for_recovery does not clear compaction_task, so a compaction that completes while mode == :locked starts a puller from the previous epoch's pull_sources.

Probed: mode=:locked with a live pull_task after a cutover.

Every other path guards this — handle_call({:ingest, ...}, _, %State{mode: :locked}) (server.ex:143), handle_info(:idle_check, %State{mode: :locked}) (server.ex:353). Blast radius is bounded today (locked ingests are ack-and-dropped, and a later unlock_after_recovery calls stop_pulling first), but a worker that is displaced rather than unlocked runs a stale-epoch puller until it exits.

One clause on the completion handler fixes it. Found by the cold audit on bedrock-zi44.
title: Compaction cutover resumes pulling on a locked worker
